title: Who, What, When
description: Admins need to see a trail of who did what and when. Log in as a known user and confirm that action shows up in the audit log with the correct actor.
successCondition: After logging in as customer@swiftcargo.test, GET /api/admin/audit-log (as an admin) includes an entry with action "auth.login", actorEmail "customer@swiftcargo.test", and a createdAt timestamp.
hints: The audit log endpoint is admin-only — log in as admin@swiftcargo.test to read it, separately from the login you're trying to observe.
